scope: Initial real GPUI smoke observations, not a controlled performance comparison or release-profile baseline.

host.provenance: Caller-supplied prebuilt host. Match this hash to native build and interaction evidence.

methodology.comparison: Two different scenarios per mode; insufficient samples for a speedup claim.
methodology.screenshotInspection: Actual after.png screenshots inspected for counter text and typed input. Long input clips visually; no pixel classifier.
methodology.freshSourceCheck: Every source file hashed by build-window.ts matched the sourceSnapshot.commit Git blob.

report.verification_scope: owned X11 window, OS-injected input, application event/paint reports and close

measurements.rss_method: sampled sum of process RSS; shared pages may be counted twice
